summary: The API-key guidance and OpenAI device-login guidance were observed in the visible provider UI; both flows were canceled without entering credentials or completing login.

observed_checks.check: Startup prerequisite and provider-management UI available
API-key guidance names the environment variable, credential storage, and chat exclusion
API-key entry canceled without supplying a key
OpenAI account setup action exposes device link and remote-device guidance
OpenAI link remains represented as a terminal hyperlink in the narrow wrapped view
OpenAI login canceled and no repeated keychain prompt appeared

actions: Started only the supplied target TMUX session.
Opened /providers and inspected Anthropic API-key setup, then pressed Escape.
Opened OpenAI management and its advertised recovery action.
Inspected the OpenAI device-login panel, redacting the device code in saved evidence, then pressed Escape.
Resized the target pane to 40 columns for the wrapping check and restored it to 150 columns.
Entered no credential, completed no login, and made no external purchase or permission change.
Returned to the empty chat composer and exited the dedicated target session with Ctrl+D.
limitations: Evidence is limited to visible raw-TMUX UI captures on macOS arm64.
The URL itself fit on one line at 40 columns; the surrounding device guidance wrapped.
Actual mouse activation or browser/native launch was not performed.
test_instruction_ambiguity: The phrase 'clickable when wrapped' is ambiguous because the 40-column view wrapped the explanatory text but not the URL itself; the capture does show the URL enclosed by OSC 8 hyperlink metadata.
